description: This file defines the interface 'GenericEngine' which specifies methods for executing services synchronously and asynchronously, handling callbacks, and managing service execution modes within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericEngine
classes.description: Interface defining methods for executing services synchronously and asynchronously, handling callbacks, and managing service modes.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously and returns the result as a Map.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously and ignores the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously, passing the result to a GenericRequester.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously without expecting a result.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Sends callback notifications based on service execution results or errors, in the specified mode.
